title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 13.7 Probability: Construct probability models.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 13.7 Probability: Construct probability models.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "13.7 Probability", prints these objectives: "Construct probability models." "Compute probabilities of equally likely outcomes." "Compute probabilities of the union of two events." "Use the complement rule to find probabilities." "Compute probability using counting theory.". The section text says: "Residents of the Southeastern United States are all too familiar with charts, known as spaghetti models, such as the one in Figure 1 . They combine a collection of weather data to predict the most likely path of a hurricane. Each colored line represents one possible path. The group of squiggly lines can begin to resemble strands of spaghetti, hence the name. In this section, we will investigate methods for making these types of predictions." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
